relevance_note: One cohort patient carries a TNFAIP3 frameshift: 'A variant in the tumor necrosis factor, alpha-induced protein (TNFAIP)3 gene (c.997dupG) resulting in a frameshift (p.A333fs^*2) was found in P10'.
method_note: Read the paper in full and recorded every value by hand; a Python script in the scratch directory only assembled the JSON and checked spans and fields (no table was transcribed by script). SCOPE: this is a 20-patient CVID whole-exome cohort; only P10 carries a TNFAIP3 variant (Table 2). The other 19 patients carry variants in other genes (NFKB1, STAT3, IL17F, IRAK4, TTC37, DDX41, NLRC3, TNFRSF1A, PLCG2) or none, and none is a relative of P10, so they were not extracted as individuals (by analogy with the rule that papers without a TNFAIP3 carrier leave patient tables empty); relatives described for P2, P3 and P15 were likewise not extracted. If all cohort members are wanted, Tables 1 and 4 hold their data. Label: tables use 'P10'; the text also says 'Patient 10'. Sex from Table 1 ('F'); the text uses no pronoun for P10. Age at diagnosis '23' is Table 1's 'Age at diagnosis' column (units not printed; read as years, consistent with P11 '22' = 'at the age of 22' in text); it is age at clinical CVID diagnosis, not at the TNFAIP3 finding. 'diagnosed with CVID 10 years ago' gives no current age, so last evaluation is not reported. The cohort is Danish (Aarhus University Hospital), but ancestry/country of origin is not stated per patient, so ethnicity_or_country is 'not reported'. Protein string 'p.A333fs^*2' is copied as it appears in the Markdown; the '^' is likely a converter rendering of a superscript asterisk. Zygosity 'heterozygous' rests on Table 2's title 'Monoallelic variants identified.' (rule 8). Inheritance: Table 3 says 'Unknown' and the text says origin could not be verified, so 'not reported'. IVIG in treatment_summary is from Table 4 ('NP (only after IVIG)') and the footnote that IgG was measured before immunoglobulin substitution; the group statement 'All patients received immunoglobulin substitution therapy, except for one' names no one, so it was not used. Low IgG, IgA below detection and low lymphocyte count are judged against the reference values printed under Table 4; P10's T-cell (156), NK (34), CD8 (48) and B-cell (68) counts are also below the printed ranges but were not recorded as separate features. The group statement 'the large majority of patients (with the exception of P15) displayed a markedly reduced fraction of isotype-switched memory B cells' was not used for P10 because 'large majority' does not clearly mean all others. Checklist: P10's anemia, thrombocytopenia and pancytopenia are not described as autoimmune (thrombocytopenia improved after splenectomy for hypersplenism), so 'cytopenia (autoimmune)' is 'not reported'; splenomegaly/hepatosplenomegaly (with portal hypertension and nodular regenerative hyperplasia) is not described as lymphoproliferation and no lymphadenopathy is stated for P10, so that item is 'not reported'; 'stomatitis' (listed under infectious manifestations) was not taken as oral ulcers. Malignancy cell for P10 in Table 1 is empty (treated as not reported). The sentence 'The variant in P10 is located in the ovarian tumor (OUT) domain as described for p.A332X, resulting in a severely truncated and rapidly degraded protein (35)' describes p.A332X from ref. 35; the authors state they did no functional validation, so no functional result is recorded for c.997dupG. cites_prior_report_of_same_patients = true rests on the patients being drawn from the Danish CVID cohort whose phenotype was described previously at cohort level (ref. 2); ref. 8 analysed a 26-patient subgroup of the same cohort, overlap with these 20 not stated. Contradictions noticed (none concern P10's TNFAIP3 variant): PLCG2 p.R956C CADD 33 in Table 2 vs 'CADD score of 35' in text; P15 age at diagnosis 27 in Table 1 vs 'at the age of 26' in text; NFKB1 variants called 'Novel' in Results but 'previously described' in the Discussion; P17's text lists elevated liver enzymes and atopia that Table 1 does not; 'OUT domain' is presumably a typo for the OTU domain.
